layout_rule: Maintain the whole map and every building/UI anchor on one fixed master coordinate system. Use uniform scale = min(viewportWidth / 1672, viewportHeight / 941); center with letterbox/pillarbox. Never stretch the map independently or reposition buildings per breakpoint.
anchor_rule: Each proposed x,y is the near/front edge of the empty stone pad, intended to receive the transparent building image bottom-center (CSS translate(-50%, -100%)). Tweak size/anchor only after viewing all building sprites overlaid together. Do not bake buildings into the background.

warnings: Normalized anchors and render widths are visually estimated, not validated in live layout
This map is richly illustrated and pixel-inspired, but not grid-exact pixel art; do not claim tile-perfect sprites
